text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen. Measuring at 1,600
meters, it
barely falls within the optimal
range of distance
Seeking the Pearl can
currently run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And not only is she going up against
Taiki
Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But today's weather has cranked up the
difficulty
even higher. Seeking the Pearl
isn't great at
running on heavy turf...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We really got the whole smorgasbord of

unfavorable conditions, didn't we? But,
well...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If we run in these conditions, then everyone can see exactly how strong Taiki and I are!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Pearl! Lookin' forward to racin'
against ya
today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's have a blast in this downpour!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki... This weather doesn't seem to
have
dampened your spirits at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm going to get to the bottom of
this and
see if you're just bluffing with
that chipper energy
of yours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have no idea what kinds of things
could
happen while we're abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This unexpected storm might be a good
test for
both of them.
